scientific_integrity: Proof is explicit; finite checks are evidence for small parameters only, not a replacement for proof. Closely related older representation-theoretic work is cited. Publication priority remains provisional.
scientific_limitations: Unital \(\mathbb F_q\)-linear algebra endomorphisms only; characteristic two and algebra \(k[x_1,\ldots,x_n]/(x_i^2)\), with \(n\ge2\). The concentration theorem fixes the field \(q\) and assumes \(n\ge64\). No extension to arbitrary finite local algebras, non-unital maps or Hopf retractions. Independent priority assessment remains open.
title: Exact algebra-retraction ranks and logarithmic cotangent corank in characteristic two
